definitions.explanation: A sensation of spinning, unsteadiness, or feeling faint, often accompanied by loss of balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がったら→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧{眩暈|めまい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I felt dizzy when I stood up suddenly.

examples.japanese: {眩暈|めまい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{倒|たお}れ→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt so dizzy that I nearly collapsed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{眩暈|めまい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the hospital because my dizziness has been bad lately.

notes:
{眩暈|めまい} (also written as {目眩|めまい} or just めまい) refers to dizziness or vertigo.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眩暈|めまい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel dizzy
- {眩暈|めまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to become dizzy
- {眩暈|めまい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: to have severe dizziness
- {眩暈|めまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel dizziness

TYPES OF DIZZINESS:
- ⟦{回転性|かいてんせい}→回転性：noentry⟧{眩暈|めまい}: rotational vertigo (spinning sensation)
- ⟦{浮動性|ふどうせい}→浮動性：noentry⟧{眩暈|めまい}: floating dizziness
- ⟦{立|た}ちくらみ→立ちくらみ：14791_tachikurami⟧: lightheadedness when standing

CAUSES:
- ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧: anemia
- ⟦{低血圧|ていけつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧: low blood pressure
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧: fatigue
- ⟦{内耳|ないじ}→内耳：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: inner ear problems

WRITING NOTE: Often written in hiragana (めまい) in everyday use.
